requirements.statement: Each router shall replay the active double-buffered calendar bank as 1,024 entries of {valid[0], in_port[2:0], out_port_mask[4:0], opcode[3:0]}. Calendar ID is 2 bits and an epoch bit selects the bank; only the inactive bank is writable and activation occurs atomically at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Per-router table preserves offline conflict-free slot ownership. Two 13-bit banks = 26,624 bits. Depth retained because m=1 exports use max_slot up to 951.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Insufficient for observed max_slot 951 without schedule rewrite proof.

requirements.upstream_compliance: Implements REQ-F-001; retains REQ-P-004 table-depth assumption.
acceptance_criteria: BFM replaying all valid entries selects exactly the encoded ingress, mask, and opcode.
Active bank is never written; no mixed-epoch replay.
Total calendar storage per router is exactly 2 x 1,024 x 13 = 26,624 bits.

requirements.statement: Calendar replay shall use slot-owned zero-buffer forwarding, while BG and escape traffic use a dedicated credited XY-DOR class with one non-borrowable BG opportunity in every 16 slots. An eligible one-flit request shall receive a per-hop grant within 16 slots and a longest-route delivery bound of 328 cycles after enqueue when downstream credit is available.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Hybrid slots retain deterministic calendar replay with a finite BG service bound.

rejected_alternatives.candidate: dedicated calendar VC with strict priority

acceptance_criteria: Mixed legal-calendar/BG BFM observes no cyclic wait; BG routes X before Y.
Under continuous eligible demand and available credit, each hop grants within 16 slots.
On 12-hop route (|dx|=5, |dy|=7), one-flit request completes within 328 cycles after enqueue.

requirements.statement: Calendar payloads shall have no queued VC storage. BG/escape payload buffering shall use five per-input FIFOs of 20 flits each (100 flits, 51,200 bits per interior router), while per-egress credit counters enforce 16 flits horizontal and 20 flits vertical.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Static calendars need no payload queues; RTT-sized BG storage sustains full-rate under H=7/V=9.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Breaks vertical credit RTT full-rate progress.

acceptance_criteria: Credit counters never allow occupancy beyond allocated capacity.
Continuously granted H or V direction sustains one 512-bit flit per cycle after fill.
No legal backpressure test loses or duplicates a non-multicast flit.

requirements.statement: Trial 2 shall implement DCA Tier A only: reduce = calendar gather + PE-local compute; allreduce = gather + PE-local compute + calendar broadcast. The router shall not instantiate combine_unit or any DCA datapath/interface. CAL_OP_PE_HANDOFF may tag PE handoff but performs no router arithmetic. Tiers B and C remain comparison-only.
requirements.resolution_rationale: USER_CONFIRMED area-first feedback forbids in-router reduction; removing Tier B saves the +2.7% combine class.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Rejected by Trial 2 binding feedback despite better small-m allreduce latency.

requirements.upstream_compliance: Satisfies A/B/C comparison mandate while selecting Tier A.
acceptance_criteria: Router RefC/BFM builds contain no combine_unit in the router datapath.
Reduce/allreduce calendar replays complete via gather/forward (+ PE handoff tags) without router arithmetic results.
No DCA transaction interface is active or required for base-router operation.

requirements.statement: The router shall use a 32-cycle calendar watchdog after expected arrival and immediate early/wrong-port detection. A violation releases its calendar reservation exactly once, preserves the flit plus remaining 5-bit leaf mask, and emits one credited XY escape packet per unserved destination; recovery starts within two cycles when queue capacity is available.
requirements.resolution_rationale: No-drop graceful degradation for off-calendar arrivals.
acceptance_criteria: Each violation class triggers exactly one reservation release.
Every remaining multicast leaf is delivered via escape/BG without loss.
Demotion action starts within 2 cycles once vc_buffers capacity exists.

requirements.statement: Analytic relative router area for Arch-A2 shall be 1.028× (or lower) versus IQ-XY baseline and strictly below Trial 1's 1.065×, using the audited component model in ppa-analytic.md.
acceptance_criteria: ppa-analytic.md reports Arch-A2 total area 1.028 or lower.
Documented delta versus Trial 1 is negative for area.
